name: Teen Service and Leadership (TSL)
org: City of San Ramon Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: Take 8 classes on teamwork, resumes, interviews and local government. Then do at least 3 volunteer shifts. Your class also helps host an event for people with special needs.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 12 to 17. San Ramon residents and non-residents can both sign up. You must volunteer for at least 3 shifts. Shifts are usually on weekends and weeknights.
pay_detail: $279 for San Ramon residents. $348.75 for non-residents.
duration: 8 Thursday classes, 4:30 to 5:45 PM, plus 3 or more volunteer shifts
deadline_text: The fall 2026 class runs Thursdays, Oct 1 to Nov 19, 2026. The page gives no sign-up deadline. Call to ask if spots are left.
how_to_apply: Sign up on the city recreation website, using the Register link on the program page. Spaces fill up fast. Call the San Ramon Community Center at 925-973-3200 with questions.
notes: Classes are at the San Ramon Community Center. Volunteer shifts can be at places like Forest Home Farms, Pine Valley Gymnasium and Central Park. The page says the program won an award from the California Parks and Recreation Society. The first class date was Oct 1, 2026, so check that you can still join.
